description_en: Queries the list of address pools in Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0
kebab_example: aliyun alidns list-cloud-gtm-address-pools --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --address-pool-name AddressPool-1 --address-pool-type IPv4 --enable-status enable --remark test --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCloudGtmAddressPools

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US: English. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文。

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the address pool
parameters.name: address_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

IPv4: The address pool contains IPv4 addresses.

IPv6: The address pool contains IPv6 addresses.

domain: The address pool contains domain names
parameters.help_zh:
地址池类型：

IPv4：表示要解析的服务地址是IPv4地址。

IPv6：表示要解析的服务地址是IPv6地址。

domain：表示要解析的服务地址是域名
parameters.name: address_pool_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the address pool. Valid values:

enable: The address pool is enabled.

disable: The address pool is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
地址池启用状态：

enable：启用状态。

disable：禁用状态
parameters.name: enable_status

parameters.help_en: The remarks for the address pool
parameters.name: remark
